title: d-Matrix Adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for Rack-Scale XPU Deployment
summary: AI inference chipmaker d-Matrix today announced it will use NVLink Fusion to connect its next-generation Raptor XPUs to NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure platform — joining a growing roster of partners building on the NVIDIA AI platform.
